interpretation: Same-wire delivery, grammar, shared public decode and amount scorer are not the observed breaking point. Missing EV alternatives and citation/amount association failures remain despite explicit include-every-alternative and lesser-of-value instructions in proposed guidance. Separate EC supports a task-execution bottleneck hypothesis, not hidden knowledge or a unique cause. Teacher input size is mainly64evidence records plus feedback, not mostly complete public statutes. All64empty/frozen outcome views are equal, but31pairs have different provenance metadata, which must not be erased as if they were independent successful runs. Do not hotcompress a positive frozen run or claim an unmeasured performance effect.
